lines.en: label beachmas4:
scene otohadidntcome1
: How long do you think I should wait before I should text her again? Two minutes? Three minutes?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我该等多久再给她发一次短信？两分钟？三分钟？

lines.en: : Why wait at all? Everyone knows that the quickest way to someone’s heart is the incessant and relentless pursuit of it. And that’s doubly true for a heart you’ve already tied tongues with.
lines.zh: : 为什么要等？谁都知道，通往一个人内心最快的路，就是无休无止、毫不放松地追逐它。而对于一颗你已经与它舌吻过的心，这话更是双倍成立。

lines.en: : First off, hearts don’t have tongues. Second, I’m not asking for sarcasm, I am asking for advice.
lines.zh: : 首先，心脏没有舌头。其次，我要的不是挖苦，是建议。

lines.en: : Yes, well, you’ve been asking for advice all morning and I am running out of answers to give you.
lines.zh: : 是吗，嗯，你一上午都在要建议，而我已经快没答案可给你了。

lines.en: : What if you just...put the phone down for a little while? Otoha might be...busy or something.
lines.zh: : 你要不就……把手机放下一会儿？Otoha 可能……在忙什么的。

lines.en: : Busy doing what? There’s no school and it’s Christmas Eve. She should be here. With her girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 忙什么？又不用上学，而且今天是平安夜。她应该在这里。和她的女朋友在一起。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you’re still calling her that after nearly two months of this childish bickering.
lines.zh: : 你还真敢在这种幼稚的拌嘴持续了快两个月之后，还管她叫那个称呼，我挺意外的。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome2
: Nodoka, come on. That was just mean.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，别这样。那太刻薄了。

lines.en: : Is there something you want to say to me, Nodoka? Do you have some sort of problem?
lines.zh: : 你有什么想对我说的吗，Nodoka？你对我有什么意见？

lines.en: : Quite the contrary. If anything, I’d say it’s my darling roommate who’s acting more irrationally out of the two of you.
lines.zh: : 恰恰相反。要说的话，我觉得你们两个里，反而是我亲爱的室友表现得更不理智。

lines.en: : At the same time, however, you are doing yourself no favors by dwelling on her as if she’s some sort of incurable illness.
lines.zh: : 但同时，你这样把她当成某种不治之症一样念念不忘，对你自己一点好处都没有。

lines.en: : Otoha will be Otoha regardless of what any of us want her to be. Which, if I had any say, would be a free-use puppet that all three of us could take advantage of whenever we wanted.
lines.zh: : 不管我们任何人想让她变成什么样，Otoha 就是 Otoha。而如果我能说了算，她会是一个我们三个随时都能用的免费人偶。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I like the idea of you using Otoha as a sex puppet even if the two of us are fighting right now.
lines.zh: : 就算我们现在在吵架，我也不太喜欢你把 Otoha 当性爱人偶这个主意。

lines.en: : Silly, Rin. It wouldn’t be just me. We’d all be using her as a sex puppet.
lines.zh: : 傻瓜，Rin。不会只有我一个。我们都会把她当性爱人偶用。

lines.en: : The jealousy would quickly transition to normalcy and, before you know it, you’d be rolling her around the city in a wheelbarrow to rent.
lines.zh: : 嫉妒很快就会变成日常，不知不觉间，你就会把她装在独轮车里推着满城去出租。

lines.en: : Though, I suppose that would no longer be “free” use. But I digress.
lines.zh: : 不过那样一来大概就不算「免费」用了。扯远了。

lines.en: : I would like to petition the room to no longer talk about Otoha the...sex puppet.
lines.zh: : 我提议本庭不再讨论 Otoha 这个……性爱人偶。

lines.en: : Seconded. Or...signed. Whatever you do with a petition to make it work.
lines.zh: : 附议。或者……联署。管它请愿书要怎么弄才生效。

lines.en: : You two are no fun. What good is a girls' night out if we can not openly discuss our fetishes with one another?
lines.zh: : 你们两个真没劲。闺蜜之夜如果不能公开讨论彼此的癖好，那还有什么意义？

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome3
: It is barely 10:00 AM.
lines.zh: : 现在才上午十点。

lines.en: : The early bird gets the sex puppet. That’s what I always say.
lines.zh: : 早起的鸟儿才有性爱人偶。我一直这么说。

lines.en: : You also have so many fetishes that we would probably need the rest of the day to talk about them.
lines.zh: : 你的癖好也太多了，我们大概得花上这一天剩下的时间才聊得完。

lines.en: : Aww, thank you. You flatter me.
lines.zh: : 哇，谢谢。你过奖了。

lines.en: : You know, sometimes I think I’m a little too horny for my own good, but then Nodoka opens her mouth and everything becomes good again.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，有时候我觉得自己色得有点过头了，但 Nodoka 一开口，一切又都正常了。

lines.en: : But it would be better if that significant other of yours would actually do her job, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不过要是你那位另一半肯好好履行她的职责，事情会更好，不是吗？

lines.en: : Sorry, how many more signatures does our petition need for us to stop talking about this?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我们这个提案还得再集几个签名才能停止聊这个？

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome4
: Wait, no. This involves me now. And if Nodoka has vital information about why I’m still a virgin after dating Otoha for over a year now, I would like to hear it.
lines.zh: : 等等，不行。现在这事扯上我了。如果 Nodoka 掌握着「为什么我和 Otoha 交往一年多了还是处女」的关键情报，我想听听。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome5
: Has it really been that long already?...
lines.zh: : 真的已经这么久了吗？……

lines.en: : Unfortunately, my mind is not one that can comprehend ever going that long without some form of sexual release.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是，我的脑子无法理解「那么长时间没有任何形式的性宣泄」这件事。

lines.en: : So either Otoha is a chronic masturbator, or she’s simply having that void filled by someone else.
lines.zh: : 所以要么 Otoha 是个长期自慰者，要么她那个空洞正由别人来填补。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome6
: Someone...else...
: You don’t...actually think Otoha would do something like that, do you? Because I was under the impression I was the first person she ever liked.
lines.zh: : 你不会……真觉得 Otoha 会做那种事吧？因为我的印象里，我是她第一个喜欢上的人。

lines.en: : Do you need to “like” someone to fornicate with them?
lines.zh: : 和人通奸需要「喜欢」对方吗？

lines.en: : No, but if you’re that into “fornication,” you would probably fornicate with someone you like...wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 不需要，但如果你那么热衷「通奸」，你大概会跟自己喜欢的人通奸……不是吗？

lines.en: : Why would she cheat on me before seeing what I can do? Maybe I’m, like...really good at sex and just none of us know it yet?
lines.zh: : 她为什么要在见识过我的本事之前就出轨？说不定我……很擅长做爱，只是我们都还不知道而已？

lines.en: : I’d be willing to help you explore and experiment if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意，我可以帮你探索和实验一下。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome7
: Are you kidding?
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : Am I?
lines.zh: : 我像在开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : Nodoka...that’s your roommate’s girlfriend. How would she feel if she heard you saying that?
lines.zh: : Nodoka……那是你室友的女朋友。她要是听见你说这些会怎么想？

lines.en: : Who knows? She’s not here. And frankly, if she’s waited this long to pull the trigger on plucking the petals off of our friend Rin’s flower, I’m sure she’d understand if someone like me did the deed instead.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？她不在这儿。而且说实话，如果她迟迟不肯动手去摘我们朋友 Rin 的那朵花，我想换成像我这样的人来代劳，她应该能理解。

lines.en: : Wow. You’re, like...a really shitty friend.
lines.zh: : 哇。你真是……一个特别烂的朋友。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome8
: But I’m your friend as well, am I not? And what’s friendlier than assisting “one of the gals” with a long overdue orgasm?
lines.zh: : 但我不也是你的朋友吗？还有什么比帮「姐妹中的一个」解决一场严重逾期的高潮更够朋友的事？

lines.en: : Not cheating on them, for starters. And if Otoha would actually answer her fucking phone, I might even tell her about this. You’re being weird as hell.
lines.zh: : 首先就别出轨，这是最基本的。而且如果 Otoha 肯接她那该死的电话，我说不定还会告诉她这件事。你简直怪到家了。

lines.en: : I can not be blamed for the things I say while surrounded by pretty girls. It is simply not fair.
lines.zh: : 被漂亮女孩包围时说出口的话，不能怪我。这不公平。

lines.en: : I feel like you become more and more like Sensei every single day. It’s worrying.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你一天比一天更像 Sensei 了。真让人担心。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome9
: More worrying than your girlfriend not answering her phone...refusing to come with you on vacation...and violently abstaining from sexual contact for over a year?
lines.zh: : 比「你女朋友不接你电话……拒绝跟你来度假……还激烈地禁欲一年多」更让人担心吗？

lines.en: : I am not insinuating anything here, but...if I were you, I’d feel a little bit worried, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我不是在暗示什么，但是……如果我是你，我会有点担心，Rin。

lines.en: : Nodoka...why are you saying things like that? Rin is clearly upset about all of this and hearing you tell her she should be worried is-
lines.zh: : Nodoka……你为什么要说这种话？Rin 显然已经为这些事很难过了，而听你说她应该担心——

lines.en: : Because someone had to say it and everyone else is a coward.
lines.zh: : 因为总得有人说，而其他人都是懦夫。

lines.en: : It is a writer’s job to move the plot forward. And when there comes a point in the story where things are not moving, someone needs to come barging into the room with a gun.
lines.zh: : 推动剧情向前是作者的职责。当故事走到某个节点、事情停滞不前时，就需要有人端着枪冲进房间。

lines.en: : Today, that someone is me...the room is you...and the gun is an open offer to alleviate some of your overflowing sexual tension in the form of a meaningless “favor” between two friends.
lines.zh: : 今天，那个人是我……房间是你……而那把枪，是一个公开的提议：以两个朋友之间一次无意义的「帮忙」的形式，缓解你那满溢的性张力。

lines.en: : That’s...
: Yeah, I’m...I’m good. But thanks.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……我不用了。不过还是谢谢。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome10
: If not me, at least let Sensei take the reins. He is experienced after all. Futaba can vouch for that. Right, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 如果不是我，至少让 Sensei 来接手吧。他毕竟经验丰富。Futaba 可以作证。对吧，Futaba？

lines.en: : Yes, but...Sensei and I...
lines.zh: : 是的，可是……Sensei 和我……

lines.en: : Yes, yes. You love him and he very likely “loves” you in whichever odd ways his brain interprets what that word means.
lines.zh: : 对，对。你爱他，而他很可能也以他脑子里那种古怪的方式「爱」着你。

lines.en: : But you love Rin as well, don’t you? And Rin loves Sensei.
lines.zh: : 可你也爱 Rin，不是吗？而 Rin 也爱 Sensei。

lines.en: : So why exactly are we preventing each other from creating a world in which we can all have sex with the teacher without anyone’s feelings being hurt?
lines.zh: : 那我们究竟为什么要互相阻拦，不去创造一个「所有人都能和老师上床、又没有任何人受伤」的世界？

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome11
: Are you trying to get your ass kicked a second time, Nodoka? Because I’m getting a little tired of you trying to talk me into cheating on my girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 你是想再挨一顿揍吗，Nodoka？因为我有点受够了你一直劝我出轨。

lines.en: : Rin, don’t.
lines.zh: : Rin，别。

lines.en: : You’re misunderstanding my position here. To me, Otoha is no more of a girlfriend to you than Sensei is a boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 你误解我的立场了。对我来说，Otoha 之于你，并不比 Sensei 之于你更像一个「女朋友」。

lines.en: : You love both of them. You have fantasized about both of them.
lines.zh: : 你两个都爱。你两个都幻想过。

lines.en: : And one of them is here for you while the other is off being aloof and sexually disinterested.
lines.zh: : 而其中一个就在你身边，另一个却在外面摆着架子、对性毫无兴趣。

lines.en: : Sensei and I aren’t like that and I don’t get why both you and Otoha keep thinking we are.
lines.zh: : Sensei 和我不是那种关系，我不明白为什么你和 Otoha 都一直觉得我们是。

lines.en: : Because you can be like that. And because I think he might be a better match for you at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 因为你们可以是那种关系。也因为我觉得说到底他可能更适合你。

lines.en: : Even if he is, that doesn’t matter. I don’t want to do that to Futaba.
lines.zh: : 就算他是，那也不重要。我不想那样对 Futaba。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome12
: That...That probably shouldn’t be the main reason, Rin...
lines.zh: : 那……那大概不该是主要理由，Rin……

lines.en: : What does “reason” even have to do with anything? Why do I need better reasons to not completely fuck up my first ever relationship?
lines.zh: : 「理由」跟这事到底有什么关系？为什么我需要更好的理由，才能不把我的第一段恋情彻底搞砸？

lines.en: : What I want is for things to work out with Otoha and me. Not Nodoka and me. And not Sensei and me.
lines.zh: : 我想要的是我和 Otoha 能有个结果。不是我和 Nodoka。也不是我和 Sensei。

lines.en: : And also to cum your brains out, which several of us would be willing to help with.
lines.zh: : 还有把你的脑子操出来——这一点我们当中有几个人都很乐意帮忙。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome13
: I can help myself with that too, you know!
lines.zh: : 那个我自己也能解决，你知道吗！

lines.en: : Why is this a thing we need to be yelling about?!
lines.zh: : 这种事有什么好吼的？！

lines.en: : Because I’m tired of Nodoka’s stupid face and I’m tired of her being horny and saying things that sound really logical but are actually kind of crazy!
lines.zh: : 因为我受够了 Nodoka 那张蠢脸，受够了她发情，受够了她说的那些听起来很有逻辑、其实有点疯的话！

lines.en: : Do you really think my face is stupid? I’ve always thought I looked kind of cute.
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我的脸蠢吗？我一直觉得自己看起来还挺可爱的。

lines.en: : You are! Just not cute enough for me to cheat on my girlfriend!
lines.zh: : 你是挺可爱的！只是还没可爱到能让我出轨的地步！

lines.en: : What if I put my glasses back on? Would that do anything for you?
lines.zh: : 那如果我把眼镜戴回来呢？有没有用？

lines.en: : A little bit but still no!
lines.zh: : 有一点点，但还是不行！

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome14
: That’s it! Nodoka, stop trying to seduce Rin! And Rin, put your stupid phone away and stop worrying about Otoha! Just leave her alone and wait for her to come to you!
lines.zh: : 够了！Nodoka，别再勾引 Rin 了！Rin，把你那破手机收起来，别再为 Otoha 操心了！别去烦她，等她自己来找你！

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome15
: But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : No “but”s, do you hear me? We are on vacation. A vacation that Otoha decided to intentionally neglect for reasons none of us even know.
lines.zh: : 没有「可是」，听见没有？我们在度假。一个 Otoha 出于我们谁都不知道的理由、故意不来参加的度假。

lines.en: : You should be mad, not trying to get her to come here.
lines.zh: : 你该生气，而不是想办法让她过来。

lines.en: : But...this is where I first confessed. And if there is ever going to be a time romantic enough for the two of us to-
lines.zh: : 但是……这里是我第一次表白的地方。如果什么时候能有浪漫到足够让我们两个——

lines.en: : I don’t care. Go into a quiet room and relieve yourself if you are that desperately aroused.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎。你要是真饥渴到那个程度，就找个安静的房间自己解决。

lines.en: : Offer is still on the-
lines.zh: : 提议依然有——

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome16
: No it’s not!
lines.zh: : 不，没有！

lines.en: : Nodoka, you need to be more considerate of other people’s feelings! Especially when you know one of those people is me and you are suggesting things that are extremely insensitive!
lines.zh: : Nodoka，你需要多替别人的感受着想！尤其当你知道其中一个人是我，而你提的建议又极其不近人情的时候！

lines.en: : I’m not trying to be “insensitive,” Futaba. I just don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 我不是想「不近人情」，Futaba。我只是不明白。

lines.en: : If Sensei wanted to have sex with me, would it really be that much of an issue?
lines.zh: : 如果 Sensei 想和我做爱，那真的会是很大的问题吗？

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome17
: Sensei wants to have sex with everyone. He is a boy and that’s just what boys do based on the...very minimal experience I have with them that comes almost entirely from books.
lines.zh: : Sensei 想和所有人做爱。他是个男的，而男的就是那样——根据我……几乎全部来自书本的、极其有限的经验。

lines.en: : Almost?
lines.zh: : 几乎？

lines.en: : That comes entirely from books!
lines.zh: : 是全部来自书本！

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome18
: And yes, it would be an issue if you and Sensei were to do it because I like him and I want him to like me more and I can’t make that happen if I have to compete with prettier girls like you two!
lines.zh: : 而且，如果你和 Sensei 真的做了，那确实会是个问题，因为我喜欢他，我想让他更喜欢我，而如果我得跟像你们两个这么漂亮的女孩竞争，我就做不到！

lines.en: : Damn it, Nodoka! Look what you did! Now Futaba’s putting herself down because you couldn’t keep your stupid, horny mouth shut!
lines.zh: : 该死，Nodoka！看看你干的好事！现在 Futaba 因为你那张又蠢又色的嘴闭不上，开始贬低自己了！

lines.en: : This is not the way I wanted this conversation to end.
lines.zh: : 这不是我想要的收场方式。

lines.en: : I know! You wanted this conversation to end in a foursome because you are incorrigible and unrealistic and need to get your head out of the clouds and remember that life is not some smut book!
lines.zh: : 我知道！你想要这场对话以四人行收场，因为你无可救药、不切实际，需要把脑袋从云里拔出来，记住生活不是什么色情小说！

lines.en: : Though it would be really cool if it was because most of them are happier than real life and elves are hot! There, I said it!
lines.zh: : 虽然如果真是的话会很酷，因为它们大多比现实幸福，而且精灵很辣！好了，我说出来了！

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome19
: Weird turn, but I agree.
lines.zh: : 转折很怪，但我同意。

lines.en: : I’m more fond of werewolves myself. Or anything with a strange type of penis, really.
lines.zh: : 我个人更喜欢狼人。或者任何一种有着奇怪阴茎的东西，真的。

lines.en: : Can we please...stop talking about Otoha...and sex...and focus on having fun and enjoying our vacation together?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……别再聊 Otoha……和性……专心玩乐、好好享受我们的假期？

lines.en: : Because if you two are going to keep bickering like this...
lines.zh: : 因为如果你们两个还要这么吵下去……

lines.en: : I am going to leave the room...
lines.zh: : 我就离开这个房间……

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome20
: And take out my frustration by having aggressive and violent relations with a man that both of you will avoid sleeping with if at all possible!
lines.zh: : 去通过和一个男人发生激烈而暴力的关系来发泄我的挫败——而你们两个只要有可能就都会避免跟他上床！

lines.en: : Is that understood?!
lines.zh: : 听明白了吗？！

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome21
: IS THAT UNDERSTOOD?!
lines.zh: : 听！明！白！了！吗？！

lines.en: : Jeez, yeah! Don’t look at me! Look at Nodoka!
lines.zh: : 天哪，明白了！别看我！看 Nodoka！

lines.en: : Question. If avoiding our teacher's phallus is no longer an option for me and I find myself in a position where I absolutely must sleep with him, what should I do then?
lines.zh: : 有个问题。如果「躲开我们老师的那根阳具」对我来说不再是个选项，而我发现自己处于一个绝对必须和他上床的境地，那我该怎么办？

lines.en: : I just need some clarity before we proceed with our “fun” sexless vacation.
lines.zh: : 我只是想在开始我们这场「有趣」的无性假期之前把事情弄清楚。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome22

: If you suddenly find yourselves thrown into an actual fantasy smut novel and need to partake in some sort of sexual mana transfer ritual to save one of your lives, fine. I will not hold that against you.
lines.zh: : 如果你们突然被扔进一本真正的奇幻色情小说里，需要参加某种性魔力转移仪式才能救某个人的命，那没问题，我不会为此记恨你们。

lines.en: : But I will not forgive you if you go out of your way to do something that will hurt me just because “you don’t understand.”
lines.zh: : 但如果你们特意去做一件会伤害我的事，仅仅因为「你不明白」，那我不会原谅。

lines.en: : You say that, but we both know you’d forgive me regardless.
lines.zh: : 你嘴上这么说，可我们俩都知道你无论如何都会原谅我。

lines.en: : Yes, but that doesn’t mean I’ll like it.
lines.zh: : 是的，但那不意味着我会乐意。

lines.en: : Just fucking agree, Nodoka. Haven’t you caused enough trouble today?
lines.zh: : 给我他妈的答应，Nodoka。你今天惹的麻烦还不够多吗？

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome23
: Yes. It seems as if I’ve been causing quite a bit of trouble lately and I’m not exactly sure how.
lines.zh: : 好。看来我最近确实惹了不少麻烦，而我也不太确定是怎么惹上的。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ve been doing anything differently than normal.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得自己做了什么跟平时不一样的事。

lines.en: : Big disagree. You’ve tried coming onto me before, but never with this level of aggression.
lines.zh: : 强烈反对。你以前也勾引过我，但从没到这种攻击性的程度。

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome24
: What’s this about cumming on you? Are you accepting my offer after all?
lines.zh: : 什么「射在你身上」？你这是终于接受我的提议了？

lines.en: scene otohadidntcome25
: That’s it! Nodoka! Go...get us drinks or something!
lines.zh: : 够了！Nodoka！去……给我们拿点喝的什么的！

lines.en: : Aww...but it’s girls' night out...
lines.zh: : 哇……可这是闺蜜之夜……

lines.en: scene black
: It is 10:00 AM!
lines.zh: : 现在是上午十点！

lines.en: : It’s actually 10:30 right now.
lines.zh: : 其实现在十点半了。

lines.en: : Which is a thing you wouldn’t know if you’d just listen to me and put your stupid phone down!
lines.zh: : 你要是肯听我的、把你那破手机放下，你就不会不知道这事！

lines.en: : Fine, fine! But only for a little while since I’m pretty sure she’s going to text back soon.
lines.zh: : 好，好！不过只放一会儿，因为我很确定她很快就会回短信的。

lines.en: : Oh, you poor girl...
lines.zh: : 噢，你这可怜的姑娘……

lines.en: : Nodoka!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I’m going. But if I come back and you two have gotten started on the foursome without me, I’m going to be quite disheartened as real friends include one another in-
lines.zh: : 好，好。我走了。不过要是我回来，发现你们两个已经背着我开始四人行了，我会很伤心的——真正的朋友是会叫上彼此的——

lines.en: : NODOKA!!!
lines.zh: : NODOKA!!!
